Para
Ejemplo

blocks.title: que = who, which o that
blocks.text: El español usa que para todo. El inglés elige según sea persona o cosa: el hombre que = the man who, el libro que = the book which / that. Y lo que después de una frase entera es which: Llegó tarde, lo que me molestó = He was late, which annoyed me.

head: Especificativa (sin comas)
Explicativa (con comas)
rows: My brother who lives in Spain is a chef. (tengo más hermanos)
My brother, who lives in Spain, is a chef. (tengo un solo hermano)
The students who studied passed. (solo ellos)
The students, who studied hard, all passed. (todos los alumnos)
that sí: The film that we saw was good.
that no: The film, which we saw last week, was good.

blocks.title: Después de una coma, nunca that
blocks.text: En una explicativa (con comas) solo se usa who o which: Madrid, which is the capital, ..., nunca Madrid, that is the capital. Funciona como en español: las comas cambian el significado.
En una oración especificativa se puede omitir who, which o that cuando es el complemento (después viene un nuevo sujeto). Los ingleses lo hacen muchísimo al hablar.

head: Con
Sin
rows: The book that I read was boring.
The book I read was boring.
The people who we met were nice.
The people we met were nice.
The man who lives here is old.
No se omite: aquí who es el sujeto.

blocks.title: El español nunca omite el 'que'
blocks.text: El libro que leí siempre lleva 'que'. Los ingleses dicen casi siempre the book I read. Reconoce esas frases al leer: parece que falta una palabra, pero está bien así.

En el inglés normal la preposición va al final de la oración de relativo, no delante como en español (la chica con la que hablaba): the girl I was talking to, the house we live in, the music I listen to. En inglés formal va delante, con whom o which: the person to whom I spoke.

blocks.title: what = lo que
blocks.text: what significa lo que: What I need is a holiday. I don't understand what you mean. Pero después de un sustantivo o de everything y all no: everything that I know (todo lo que sé), nunca everything what.

rows: The man which called you is here.
The man who called you is here.
Para personas: who.
My mother, that is a teacher, lives in Delft.
My mother, who is a teacher, lives in Delft.
Después de una coma, nada de that.
He was late, what annoyed me.
He was late, which annoyed me.
Después de una frase entera: which.
The girl who her father is a pilot.
The girl whose father is a pilot.
Posesión: whose.
That's the shop where I bought it there.
That's the shop where I bought it.
where ya sustituye a 'allí'.
Everything what he said was true.
Everything that he said was true.
Después de everything: that.
The man lives here is old.
The man who lives here is old.
who como sujeto no se puede omitir.

blocks.text: Completa con who, which, that, whose, where o what. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.q: The doctor ______ treated me was very kind.
items.full: The doctor who treated me was very kind.

items.q: Is this the bus ______ goes to the airport?
items.full: Is this the bus which goes to the airport?

items.q: That's the man ______ car was stolen.
items.full: That's the man whose car was stolen.

items.q: This is the café ______ we first met.
items.full: This is the café where we first met.

items.q: London, ______ is the capital of the UK, is very expensive.
items.full: London, which is the capital of the UK, is very expensive.

items.q: She failed the exam, ______ surprised everyone.
items.full: She failed the exam, which surprised everyone.
I don't understand what you're saying.

items.q: My sister, ______ lives in Canada, is visiting us.
items.full: My sister, who lives in Canada, is visiting us.

items.q: The music I listen ______ is mostly jazz.
items.full: The music I listen to is mostly jazz.
All that you need is love.

items.q: The student ______ phone rang had to leave.
items.full: The student whose phone rang had to leave.

items.q: That was the year ______ I finished school.
items.full: That was the year when I finished school.

items.q: La mujer que vive al lado es médica.
items.a: The woman who lives next to us is a doctor.

items.q: Este es el hotel donde nos alojamos.
items.a: This is the hotel where we stayed.

items.q: Él llegó tarde, lo que me molestó.
items.a: He was late, which annoyed me.

items.q: La chica con la que hablaba es española.
items.a: The girl I was talking to is Spanish.
